title: [Subcontracting] Added actionable notification when a vendor does not have a subcontracting location code
summary: A notification now alerts users when a vendor lacks a subcontracting location code, enabling early detection of missing configuration before downstream processes require it.
key_points: Adds an actionable notification when a vendor has no subcontracting location code
Notification logic lives in Subc. Notification Mgmt.; the Work Center Card page extension is updated to use it
Lets users spot the missing setup before a later process needs it
UI tests added for the new notification
quote: Added so the user can detect the missing subcontracting location code before a future process requires it.
